events.title: ARCHIVIST: Tidy Up & Sort has reached 5,000 wishlists! THANKS!
events.summary: A huge thank you to everyone who has wishlisted the game, played the demo, shared feedback, or simply followed the project :> Thank you so much for your support! P.S. By the way, here’s what roughly 5,000 documents look like! P.P.S. Just curious -- what draws you to this genre? events.title: Title Update
